meta.name: Perpetual Clockwork Dampening Seal
meta.description: Forged by the Perpetual Clockwork Deep-Bore Syndicate from lark newt rivet ore and cinderslag. Placed on a tile, this basalt-edged device hums with a strict metallurgical resonance, preventing unwanted splash damage by heavily clamping incoming damage when not directly struck. Reduces incoming secondary damage, ensuring precious blocks are left intact.
